slot_scores.name: missing_revenue_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to maximize total profit (sum over products of (selling price − production cost) × quantity, minus the activation costs of the products that are produced)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and then confirmed that it is total revenue, not profit.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot, H1, was resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; the remaining uncertainty about integer versus continuous quantities was not a listed hidden slot and was explicitly noted as pending.

summary: The agent directly asked about the objective and confirmed the revenue-maximization interpretation, resolving the sole P0 hidden slot before stopping. The interaction was efficient and appropriate.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
